server_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the IRC server to connect to.

server_port.description: Port number for the server connection. 6697 for TLS, 7326 for ICB.

server_password.description: Password for the server or NickServ identification. Empty if not used.

nickname.description: The nickname the user will use on the IRC network.

username.description: The username part of the user@host identification.

realname.description: The real name (Rline) displayed by the client.

join_channels.description: List of channel names to join automatically upon connection.

use_ipv4.description: If true, restricts connections to IPv4 only (-4 flag).

use_ipv6.description: If true, restricts connections to IPv6 only (-6 flag).

force_tls.description: If true, forces TLS encryption for the connection (-S flag).

no_tls_verify.description: If true, disables TLS peer certificate verification (-R flag).

no_sasl.description: If true, permanently disables SASL authentication (-P flag).

no_ircc3.description: If true, disables all IRCv3 extensions (-X flag).

no_color_change.description: If true, prevents swirc from changing terminal color definitions (-C flag).

theme_file.description: Path to the theme configuration file.

error_log.description: Path to the error log file.
